NAHHAS:v4p134/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p134/r7.speaker: أهل المدينة
NAHHAS:v4p134/r7.anchor: قراءة أهل المدينة وقرأ أهل الكوفة ( فاعتلوه )

NAHHAS:v4p134/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p134/r8.speaker: أهل الكوفة
NAHHAS:v4p134/r8.claim: The Kufans read فاعتلوه; both forms are dialectal, though analogy favors kasra like ضربه يضربه.
NAHHAS:v4p134/r8.anchor: وقرأ أهل الكوفة ( فاعتلوه ) وهما لغتان إلا أن القياس الكسر

NAHHAS:v4p134/r9.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p134/r9.speaker: الخليل وسيبويه
NAHHAS:v4p134/r9.claim: Khalil and Sibawayh permit retaining the wāw in connected speech in خذوهو and فاعتلوهو, although deletion is preferred.
NAHHAS:v4p134/r9.anchor: وأجاز الخليل وسيبويه خذوهو فاعتلوهو بإثبات الواو في الإدراج إلا أن الاختيار حذفها

NAHHAS:v4p134/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p134/r10.speaker: سيبويه
NAHHAS:v4p134/r10.claim: Sibawayh says the wāw was originally present and was deleted because two long-vowel letters came together; others say it was removed to avoid two vowelless letters.
NAHHAS:v4p134/r10.anchor: فمذهب سيبويه أن الأصل خذوهو بإثبات الواو إلا أنها حذفت لاجتماع حرفين من حروف المد واللين

NAHHAS:v4p134/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p134/r11.speaker: الضحاك
NAHHAS:v4p134/r11.claim: Al-Dahhak says the command to take and drag him was revealed about Abu Jahl, and glosses فاعتلوه as push him.
NAHHAS:v4p134/r11.anchor: وقال جويبر عن الضحاك أنه نزل في أبي جهل خذوه فاعتلوه إذا أمر به يوم القيامة قال الضحاك فاعتلوه فادفعوه

NAHHAS:v4p134/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p134/r12.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p134/r12.claim: سواء الجحيم means the middle of Hell.
NAHHAS:v4p134/r12.anchor: ( إلى سواء الجحيم ) أي إلى وسط الجحيم

RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r14.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r14.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r14.claim: خذوه means seize the sinner, and اعتلوه means drag him forcefully toward Hell's middle.
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r14.anchor: ثم قال : { خذوه } أي خذوا الأثيم { فاعتلوه } قرىء بكسر التاء

RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r15.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r15.speaker: الليث
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r15.claim: Al-Layth defines عتل as grabbing a man and dragging him away to a prison or similar place; he also illustrates forceful leading of a camel by its halter.
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r15.anchor: قال الليث : العتل أن تأخذ بمنكث الرجل فتعتله أي تجره إليك وتذهب به إلى حبس

RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r16.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r16.speaker: ابن السكيت
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r16.claim: Ibn al-Sikkit says عتلته إلى السجن and أعتلته mean taking someone to prison with a forceful shove.
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r16.anchor: وقال ابن السكيت عتلته إلى السجن وأعتلته إذا دعته دفعا عنيفا

RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r17.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r17.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r17.claim: The verb is read with kasra or damma on the ت; both forms are sound Arabic, like paired forms يعكفون/يكعفون and يعرضون/يعرشون.
RAZI-FULL:v27p215/r17.anchor: وذكروا في اللغتين ضم التاء وكسرها وهما صيحيان مثل يعكفون ويكعفون

RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r1.claim: سواء الجحيم means the middle of Hell.
RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى : { إلى سواء الجحيم } أي إلى وسط الجحيم

RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r2.claim: The expected wording would pour boiling water from above onto the head; describing pouring torment from that water is a stronger metaphor.
RAZI-FULL:v27p215#2/r2.anchor: وكان الأصل أن يقال : ثم صبوا من فوق رأسه الحميم أو يصب من فوق رؤوسهم الحميم إلا أن هذه الاستعارة أكمل في المبالغة

STUDYQURAN:44:47/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:44:47/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:44:47/r1.claim: “Seize him” refers to the sinner and is God’s command to the angels who guard Hell, the zabāniyah.
STUDYQURAN:44:47/r1.anchor: Seize him—that is, the sinner—is God’s command to the angels who serve as the guardians of Hell (

STUDYQURAN:44:47/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:44:47/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:44:47/r2.claim: Another passage describes the disbelievers being violently thrust into Hell on Judgment Day.
STUDYQURAN:44:47/r2.anchor: the Day of Judgment is referred to as a day when the disbelievers are thrust into the Fire of Hell with [violent] thrusting (52:13)

TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r1.claim: On Judgment Day the sinner is driven forcefully from behind and dragged to the middle of Hell.
TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {خذوه فاعتلوه إلى سواء الجحيم} [الدخان: 47] قال: «خذوه فادفعوه»

TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r2.claim: Mujahid explains اعتلوه as take him and push him.
TAB-FULL:v21p59#2/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {خذوه فاعتلوه إلى سواء الجحيم} [الدخان: 47] قال: «خذوه فادفعوه»

TAB-FULL:v21p60/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p60/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v21p60/r1.claim: Some readers in Medina and Mecca read the tāʾ with kasra; al-Ṭabarī accepts either form as a recognized Arabic dialect. Qatadah glosses the endpoint as the middle of the fire.
TAB-FULL:v21p60/r1.anchor: عن قتادة، {إلى سواء الجحيم} [الدخان: 47] «إلى وسط النار»

TAB-FULL:v21p60/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p60/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v21p60/r2.claim: Qatadah glosses the middle of Hell as the middle of the fire.
TAB-FULL:v21p60/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، {إلى سواء الجحيم} [الدخان: 47] «إلى وسط النار»

BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r1.claim: The command is addressed to the guards of Hell on Judgment Day: seize the sinner, taking him by his forelock and feet.
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r1.anchor: {خذوه} على إرادة القول والخطاب للزبانية ؛ أي : يقال : للزبانية يوم القيامة خذوا الأثيم ، فلا يأخذونه إلا بالنواصي والأقدام.

BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r2.claim: فاعتلوه means drag him forcefully and harshly; عتل involves grasping clothing or the like and hauling with coercion.
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r2.anchor: {فاعتلوه} ؛ أي : جروه بالعنف والقهر ، فإن العتل الأخذ بمجامع الثوب ونحوه وجره بقهر وعنف.

BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r3.speaker: تاج المصادر
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r3.claim: Taj al-Masadir glosses العتل as pulling violently.

BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r4.speaker: القاموس
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r4.claim: Al-Qamus defines عتله as dragging him forcefully; مُعْتَل denotes one strong enough for this.
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r4.anchor: وفي "القاموس" : عتله يعتله ويعتله ، فالعتل جره عنيفا ، فحمله

BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r5.claim: The middle of Hell means its central, principal part, equidistant from every side.
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r5.anchor: وسطها ومعظمها الذي تستوي المسافة إليه من جميع جوانبه.

BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r8.claim: The scene also signifies the torment of regret and deprivation and the burning ache of separation in the depths of the fires.
BURSEVI:v8p330#3/r8.anchor: وفي الآية إشارة إلى عذاب الحسرة والحرمان وحرقة الهجران في قعر النيران.

TABATABAI:44:47-54/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r1.claim: Iʿtilā means forcibly shaking, pushing, or driving someone.

TABATABAI:44:47-54/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r2.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of Hell.

TABATABAI:44:47-54/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r3.claim: The command is addressed to the angels assigned to Hell: seize the sinner and drive him violently to its center so it envelops him.
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r3.anchor: والخطاب للملائكة الموكلين على النار أي نقول للملائكة خذوا الأثيم وادفعوه بعنف إلى وسط النار لتحيط به

TABATABAI:44:47-54/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r4.claim: He links Hell’s enveloping the sinner to the statement that Hell surrounds the unbelievers.
TABATABAI:44:47-54/r4.anchor: قال تعالى وإن جهنم لمحيطة بالكافرين

TABRISI:44:41-47/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:44:41-47/r2.speaker: أهل الكوفة وأبو جعفر وأبو عمرو
TABRISI:44:41-47/r2.claim: The Kufans, Abū Jaʿfar, and Abū ʿAmr read the tāʾ of faʿtilūhu with kasrah; the other readers use ḍammah.
TABRISI:44:41-47/r2.anchor: وقرأ أهل الكوفة وأبو جعفر وأبو عمرو

TABRISI:44:41-47/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:44:41-47/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:44:41-47/r5.claim: Faʿtilūhu means to lead him away by force; the two forms yaʿtalu and yaʿkufu, and yufsigu and yufsugu, are dialectal variants.
TABRISI:44:41-47/r5.anchor: ويعتل مثل يعكف ويعكف ويفسق ويفسق في أنهما لغتان ومعنى فاعتلوه قودوه بعنف

TABRISI:44:47-50/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:44:47-50/r1.speaker: الشاعر
TABRISI:44:47-50/r1.claim: The cited line uses yaʿtilūnahu for violently dragging someone, likening him to a large slaughter camel.
TABRISI:44:47-50/r1.anchor: فيا ضيعة الفتيان إذ يعتلونه ببطن الثرى مثل الفنيق المسدم

TABRISI:44:47-50/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:44:47-50/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TABRISI:44:47-50/r2.claim: Mujāhid explains the command as dragging the sinner on his face.
TABRISI:44:47-50/r2.anchor: وقيل معناه جروه على وجهه عن مجاهد

TABRISI:44:47-50/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:44:47-50/r3.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:44:47-50/r3.claim: Qatāda says “the middle of Hell”; the middle is called its sawāʾ because it is equally distant from the surrounding edges.
TABRISI:44:47-50/r3.anchor: إلى وسط النار عن قتادة وسمي وسط الشيء سواه لاستواء المسافة بينه وبين أطرافه المحيطة به

TABRISI:44:47-50/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:44:47-50/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:44:47-50/r4.claim: Sawāʾ can also mean justice or evenness.

THALABI:v8p355#2/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p355#2/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p355#2/r1.claim: Take him refers to the sinner; the guards are to bring him in, push him, and drive him toward the fire.
THALABI:v8p355#2/r1.anchor: في البطون كغلي الحميم خذوه يعني الأثيم. فاعتلوه فأدخلوه وادفعوه وسوقوه الى النار.

THALABI:v8p355#2/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p355#2/r2.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p355#2/r2.claim: Atl means driving by force, pushing, and pulling.
THALABI:v8p355#2/r2.anchor: يقال: عتله يعتله عتلا إذا ساقه بالعنف والدفع والجذب.

THALABI:v8p355#2/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p355#2/r3.speaker: الفرزدق
THALABI:v8p355#2/r3.claim: Al-Farazdaq's line uses taʿtal to mean driving or dragging someone forcibly.
THALABI:v8p355#2/r3.anchor:
قال الفرزدق:
ليس الكرام بنا حليك أباهم … حتى ترد إلى عطية تعتل

THALABI:v8p355#2/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p355#2/r4.speaker: أبو جعفر وأبو مرو وأهل الكوفة
THALABI:v8p355#2/r4.claim: Abu Jaʿfar, Abu Amr, and the Kufans read the t with kasra; the remaining readers read it with damma.
THALABI:v8p355#2/r4.anchor: وفيه لغتان: كسر التاء، وهي قراءة أبي جعفر وأبي مرو وأهل الكوفة، وضمها وهي قراءة الباقي.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r1.speaker: أبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r1.claim: Abu Ishaq takes the command as an address to the angels: seize the sinner and drag him.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r1.anchor: قال أبو إسحاق: المعنى: يا أيها الملائكة خذوه فاعتلوه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r2.speaker: الليث
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r2.claim: Al-Layth explains dragging as grabbing a man's lapel and pulling him toward prison or calamity; he also compares forcefully leading a camel by its reins.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r2.anchor: قال الليث: العتل أن تأخذ بتلبيب الرجل فتعتله أي: تجره إليك

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r3.speaker: ابن السكيت
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r3.claim: Ibn al-Sikkit says that both عتلته and عتنته mean pushing someone violently.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r3.anchor: وقال ابن السكيت: عتلته إلى السجن، وعتنته فأنا أعتله وأعتنه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r4.claim: Both forms with the tāʾ pronounced with ḍamma or kasra are valid Arabic forms, like the two cited forms of يعكفون and يعرشون.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r4.anchor: ضم التاء وكسرها وهما صحيحان (¬6) مثل: {يعكفون}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r5.claim: The Farazdaq's poetic use of تعتل witnesses the sense of forcefully leading or dragging someone.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r5.anchor: ليس الكرام بناحليك أباهم ... حتى ترد إلى عطية تعتل

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r6.speaker: مجاهد ومقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r6.claim: Mujahid and Muqatil explain the command as pushing the sinner face-down.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r6.anchor: قال مجاهد ومقاتل: ادفعوه على وجهه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r7.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r7.claim: Al-Kalbi says they are to drive him to the middle of Hell, as in the description of someone seeing him there in 37:55.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p119#2/r7.anchor: وقال الكلبي: سوقوه إلى سواء الجحيم قال: وسط الجحيم

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:44:42-51/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:44:42-51/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:44:42-51/r4.claim: The sinner is driven along roughly and forcefully to the middle of Hell.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:44:42-51/r4.anchor: يعني: الأثيم { فاعتلوه } سوقوه [سوقا] بالعنف { إلى سواء الجحيم } وسط الجحيم

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r1.claim: The passage describes resurrection and afterlife through worldly perceptions, imaginings, desires, and fears, including hell's punishment and the blessings prepared for the good.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r1.anchor: Dünyanın fâni, insanların ölümlü oldukları açıklanınca yeniden dirilişi takip edecek zaman içinde nelerin olacağı, insanların dünyada yapıp ettiklerine göre ebedî hayatta nelerle karşılaşacakları

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r2.claim: Judgment day is the reckoning after resurrection, when the good and evil, guilty and innocent, oppressors and oppressed, and those bound for Paradise or Hell are separated and repaid for their deeds.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r2.anchor: “Yargı günü”nden maksat kıyameti takip edecek olan sorgulama ve yargılamanın yapılacağı zamandır. Bu muhâkeme sonunda iyiler ve kötüler

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r3.claim: The zakkum tree in verse 43 is a tree in Hell used for punishment.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:44:40/r3.anchor: 43. âyetteki “zakkum ağacı” cehennemde bulunan ve azap için kullanılan bir ağaçtır

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p359/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p359/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p359/r7.claim: Sawāʾ can mean the middle or center.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p359/r7.anchor: والثالث : الوسط . ومنه قوله تعالى في الدخان

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r1.claim: Iʿtilūhu means drag or drive him forcibly and roughly.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r2.claim: He notes a reading with a different vowel on the verb; the same form is used of someone being led forcibly to the ruler.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r2.anchor: وتقرأ: {فاعتلوه} يقال: جيء بفلان يعتل إلى السلطان؛ أي يقاد.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r3.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r3.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p403#8/r3.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of the Fire.

SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r1.speaker: نافع وابن كثير وابن عامر
SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r1.claim: Nafi, Ibn Kathir, and Ibn Amir read اعتلوه with ḍamma on ʿayn; the others use kasra. Both are dialect variants of عتله, to drive someone roughly.
SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r1.anchor: قرأ نافع وابن كثير وابن عامر بضم عين " اعتلوه ". والباقون بكسرها، وهما لغتان

SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r2.claim: The verb means to lead someone harshly and roughly; عتل describes a coarse, brutal person.
SAMIN-DURR:44:47/r2.anchor: في مضارع عتله أي: ساقه بجفاء وغلظة ك عرش يعرش ويعرش. والعتل: الجافي الغليظ.

ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r1.claim: The verb faʿtilūhu is read with either ḍamma or kasra on its tāʾ.

ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r2.claim: The command is addressed to the angels and means to seize him and drag him away roughly and forcefully.
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r2.anchor: المعنى يا أيها الملائكة خذوه فاعتلوه. والعتل أن يؤخذ فيمضى به بعسف

ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r3.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of Hell.
ZAJJAJ:v4p428/r3.anchor: إلى سواء الجحيم) إلى وسط الجحيم

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p220/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p220/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p220/r2.claim: The passage presents intellectual and historical evidence for reward and punishment, then depicts the fates of believers and disbelievers; God treats them differently with complete justice.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p220/r2.anchor: logical as well as historical arguments in favour of reward and punishment are briefly referred to. It is mentioned in detail that God will not deal equally between those who spent their lives

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r3.claim: The coming section identifies disbelief in life after death as the cause of Quraysh rebellion and heedlessness of the future.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r3.anchor: the real reason for the rebelliousness of the Quraysh is highlighted: they do not imagine that there is life after this worldly existence

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r4.claim: The section first offers intellectual and natural arguments for reward and punishment, then describes the fate of believers and disbelievers.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p239/r4.anchor: first the intellectual and natural arguments which substantiate the law of reward and punishment are cited. After this, the fate of both the believers and the disbelievers is depicted.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r4.claim: For eloquence, the source of the pronouncement is left unstated; the command itself is given, with Hell’s wardens directed to seize and drag the sinner deep into Hell and pour boiling water over him.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r4.anchor: Giving due consideration to eloquence, it is suppressed that the above words will be proclaimed to these people from God.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r5.claim: The wardens are ordered to seize the sinner, drag him to Hell’s depth, and pour boiling water over his head as punishment.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p243/r5.anchor: wardens of Hell will be directed to seize these people and drag them to the depth of Hell

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r1.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r1.claim: Ibn Kathir, Nafi, and Ibn Amir read اعتلوه with ḍamma on ت; most others read kasra, while Abu Amr has reports of both vowels or kasra alone.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r1.anchor: فقرأ ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر: خذوه فاعتلوه بضم التاء. عبيد عن أبي عمرو: فاعتلوه

FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r2.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r2.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r2.claim: اعتلوه means drive or lead him forcibly; the two vowel patterns occur in paired Arabic verb forms such as يعكف/يعكف.
FARISI-HUJJA:v6p165#2/r2.anchor: قيل في قوله: فاعتلوه: قودوه بعنف، ويعتل ويعتل مثل يعكف ويعكف

NASHR:v2p371/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p371/r3.speaker: نافع وابن كثير وابن عامر ويعقوب
NASHR:v2p371/r3.claim: Nafiʿ, Ibn Kathir, Ibn Amir, and Yaʿqub read the tāʾ in فاعتلوه with ḍamma; the others use kasra.
NASHR:v2p371/r3.anchor: فاعتلوه فقرأ نافع وابن كثير وابن عامر ويعقوب بضم التاء

QIRAAT-ER:44:47:3#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:44:47:3#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:44:47:3#1/r1.claim: The imperative’s internal vowel shifts from i to u, preserving the root and command force.
QIRAAT-ER:44:47:3#1/r1.anchor: Canonical vowel variant changes the internal vowel from i to u in the imperative

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p209/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p209/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p209/r1.claim: Qatāda says the threat was revealed about Abū Jahl, who boasted that no one between Mecca's two mountains was more powerful or noble; God answers him ironically, “Taste, you are the mighty, noble one.”
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p209/r1.anchor: عن قتادة قال لما نزلت في أبي جهل ﴿ خذوه فاعتلوه إلى سواء الجحيم ﴾ قال قتادة قال أبو جهل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p394#2/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p394#2/r15.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p394#2/r15.claim: ʿAtalah means to drive someone roughly, forcefully and humiliatingly; al-muʿtal is an uncouth, coarse person.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p394#2/r15.anchor: عتله: ساقه بعنف ودفع وإهانة، والمعتل: الجافي الغليظ.

ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r1.claim: Take him is an implied quotation addressed to the wardens: they are told, Take him.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r1.anchor: على إرادة القول والمقول له الزبانية أي ويقال لهم خذوه

ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r2.speaker: الراغب
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r2.claim: Al-Raghib defines ʿatl as seizing something and dragging it forcefully; specifying a garment is unnecessary, since violent dragging while holding it is the core sense.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r2.anchor: قال الراغب : العتل الأخذ بمجامع الشيء وجره بقهر

ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r3.speaker: الأعمش ومجاهد
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r3.claim: Al-Aʿmash and Mujahid gloss it as breaking him as one breaks firewood; the author notes that this requires implication or attachment of the prepositional phrase to take him, while dragging is the familiar sense.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r3.anchor: وقال اتل أعمش ومجاهد : معنى ( اعتلوه ) اقصفوه كما يقصف الحطب

ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r4.speaker: زيد بن علي والحجازيان وابن عامر ويعقوب
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r4.claim: These readers pronounce the tāʾ with ḍamma; the reading with fatḥ is the majority form, and both are dialectal patterns.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r4.anchor: وقرأ زيد بن علي والحجازيان وابن عامر ويعقوب ( فاعتلوه ) ) بضم التاء

ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r5.speaker: الحسن وقتادة والأعرج
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r5.claim: The ḍamma reading is also transmitted from al-Hasan, Qatada, and al-Aʿraj.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r5.anchor: وروي ذلك عن الحسن وقتادة والأعرج

ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r6.claim: Sawāʾ al-Jahim means its middle, called sawāʾ because it is equidistant from all sides.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p133#4/r6.anchor: أيوسطه وسمي سواء لاستواء بعد جميع أطرافه بالنسبة إليه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r1.claim: The command is addressed to the infernal guards, and the one they seize is the sinner.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r1.anchor: أي يقال للزبانية: خذوه، يعني الأثيم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r2.speaker: أهل الكوفة وأبو جعفر وأبو عمرو والباقون
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r2.claim: The Kūfans, Abū Jaʿfar, and Abū ʿAmr read ʿatlihi with kasra on tāʾ; the others use ḍamma, and both are dialects.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r2.anchor: قرأ أهل الكوفة، وأبو جعفر، وأبو عمرو: بكسر التاء

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r3.claim: ʿAtl means to push and drive with force, pulling and dragging him roughly.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r3.anchor: أي ادفعوه وسوقوه، يقال: عتله يعتله عتلا إذا ساقه بالعنف والدفع والجذب

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p236#2/r4.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of Hellfire.

BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r9.claim: The command presupposes an unspoken “they said,” and its addressees are the wardens of Hell.
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r9.anchor: على إرادة القول والمقول له الزبانية

BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r10.claim: ʿAtl means to seize something by its parts and drag it forcibly; here the command is to drag him.
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r10.anchor: فجروه والعتل الأخذ بمجامع الشيء وجره بقهر

BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r11.speaker: الحجازيان وابن عامر ويعقوب
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r11.claim: The Hijazis, Ibn ʿAmir, and Yaʿqub read the verb with ḍamma; the two forms are dialectal variants.
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r11.anchor: وقرأ الحجازيان وابن عامر ويعقوب بالضم وهما لغتان. { إلى سواء الجحيم } وسطه

BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r12.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r12.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r12.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of the blazing Fire.
BAYDAWI-FULL:44:42-47/r12.anchor: وهما لغتان. { إلى سواء الجحيم } وسطه

BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r4.claim: The command means to seize him forcibly, leaving him no control over his own affairs.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r4.anchor: أخذ قهر فلا تدعوه يملك من أمره شيئا

BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r5.claim: They drag him by force, with roughness, violence, and speed, toward torment and humiliation, as though he were being carried.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r5.anchor: بغلظة وعنف وسرعة إلى العذاب والإهانة بحيث يكون كأنه محمول

BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r6.speaker: الرازي
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r6.claim: Al-Razi defines عتل as gripping the gathered front of a person's garment at the chest and dragging him.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r6.anchor: وقال الرازي في اللوامع : والعتل أن يأخذ بمجامع ثوبه عند صدره يجره

BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r7.claim: The reading with ḍamma conveys greater severity and roughness than the reading with kasra.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r7.anchor: وقراءة الضم أدل على تناهي الغلظة والشدة من قراءة الكسر

BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r8.claim: سواء means the middle; الجحيم is the fiercely blazing Fire and the place from which the tree that feeds him emerges.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p81/r8.anchor: { إلى سواء } أي وسط { الجحيم } أي النار التي في غاية الاضطرام والتوقد

DURR-FULL:v7p419/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r8.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r8.claim: Mujāhid explains “drag him forcefully” as crushing him as one crushes firewood.
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r8.anchor: عن مجاهد {خذوه فاعتلوه} فاقصفوه كما يقصف الحطب

DURR-FULL:v7p419/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r9.speaker: الضحاك
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r9.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk glosses the command as taking him and pushing him into the middle of Hell.
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r9.anchor: عن الضحاك {خذوه فاعتلوه إلى سواء الجحيم} قال: خذوه فادفعوه في وسط الجحيم

DURR-FULL:v7p419/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r10.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r10.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr explains the middle of Hell as its center.
DURR-FULL:v7p419/r10.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير {إلى سواء الجحيم} قال: وسط الجحيم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p315/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p315/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p315/r1.claim: إلى سواء الجحيم attaches to both خذوه and فاعتلوه, since both imply driving him forcefully.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p315/r1.anchor: وقوله : { إلى سواء الجحيم } يتنازعه في التعلق كل من فعلي { خذوه فاعتلوه } لتضمنهما : سوقوه سوقا عنيفا .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r8.claim: On that Day the command is addressed to the angels concerning this sinner: seize him and drag him away.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r8.anchor: معناه: يقال يومئذ للملائكة عن هذا الأثيم خذوه فاعتلوه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r9.claim: ʿAtl means driving someone with force, humiliation, and sustained shoving, as criminals are led.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r9.anchor: والعتل: السوق بعنف وإهانة ودفع قوي متصل، كما يساق أبدا مرتكب الجرائم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r10.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r10.claim: They read the tāʾ with ḍamma; the others read it with kasra. Both forms are also reported from Abu ʿAmr, al-Hasan, Qatada, and al-Aʿraj.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p76#2/r10.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر: بضم التاء، والباقون بكسرها، وقد روي الضم عن أبي عمرو

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r1.claim: The command “take him” is addressed to the keepers of Hell.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى ﴿ خذوه ﴾ أي يقال للزبانية خذوه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r2.speaker: ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر ويعقوب
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r2.claim: Ibn Kathir, Nafiʿ, Ibn ʿAmir, and Yaʿqub read the tāʾ with ḍamma; the others read it with kasra.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r2.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير ونافع وابن عامر ويعقوب بضم التاء وكسرها الباقون

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r3.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r3.claim: Ibn Qutayba says it means to drag him roughly, as in bringing someone forcibly to the ruler.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r3.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة ومعناه قودوه بالعنف يقال جيء بفلان يعتل إلى السلطان

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p350/r4.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of the fire.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r1.claim: A report says that when God commands the keepers of Hell to seize the condemned person, seventy thousand of them rush toward him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r1.anchor: أنه تعالى إذا قال للزبانية {خذوه} ابتدره سبعون ألفا منهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r2.claim: The condemned disbeliever is hauled away, dragged and shoved from behind.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r2.anchor: أي: سوقوه سحبا ودفعا في ظهره

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r3.claim: Mujahid glosses the command as taking the person and pushing him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r3.anchor: قال مجاهد: {خذوه فاعتلوه} أي: خذوه فادفعوه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r4.speaker: الفرزدق
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r4.claim: Al-Farazdaq’s line uses the cognate تعتل for being dragged back, illustrating the force of اعتلوه.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r4.anchor:
وقال الفرزدق:
ليس الكرام بناحليك أباهم … حتى ترد إلى عطية تعتل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p260/r5.claim: The center of Hell is meant by “the middle of the Blaze.”

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r5.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r5.claim: Al-Hasan glosses iʿtiluhu as dragging him away.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r5.anchor: قاله الحسن . الثاني : فادفعوه , قاله مجاهد

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r6.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r6.claim: Mujahid glosses iʿtiluhu as pushing him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r6.anchor: الثاني : فادفعوه , قاله مجاهد . الثالث : فسوقوه , حكاه الكلبي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r7.speaker: الكلبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r7.claim: Al-Kalbi glosses iʿtiluhu as leading him along.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r8.speaker: الأعمش
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r8.claim: Al-A'mash glosses it as wrenching him like firewood.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r8.anchor: الرابع : فاقصفوه كما يقصف الحطب , حكاه الأعمش : الخامس : فردوه بالعنف

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r9.speaker: ابن قتيبة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r9.claim: Ibn Qutayba glosses iʿtiluhu as driving him back roughly.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r9.anchor: الخامس : فردوه بالعنف , قاله ابن قتيبة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r10.speaker: الفرزدق
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r10.claim: Al-Farazdaq's verse uses the related verb for forcefully dragging someone back.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r10.anchor:
قال الفرزدق :
ليس الكرام بناحليك أباهم … حتى ترد إلى عطية تعتل

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r11.speaker: ابن عباس والضحاك وقتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r11.claim: Ibn Abbas, al-Dahhak, and Qatada say sawa al-Jahim means the middle of Hell.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r11.anchor: أحدهما : وسط الجحيم , قاله ابن عباس والضحاك وقتادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r12.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r12.claim: Al-Hasan instead takes it as Hell's main part, where heat reaches him from every side.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p257/r12.anchor: الثاني : معظم الجحيم يصيبه الحر من جوانبها , قاله الحسن .

MUJAHID:v2p589#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p589#2/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p589#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد في قوله ﴿ فاعتلوه ﴾ يقول ادفعوه

MUQATIL:44:44-50/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:44:44-50/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:44:44-50/r7.claim: The one seized is Abu Jahl; the guards push him face-first to the middle of Hell, its sixth gate.
MUQATIL:44:44-50/r7.anchor: { خذوه } ، يعنى أبا جهل، { فاعتلوه } ، يقول: فادفعوه على وجهه،

NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r1.claim: The person being seized is the sinner.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r2.claim: Iʿtilūhu means lead or drag him with violence and roughness.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r3.claim: The form faʿtilūhu is attributed to the Meccans, Nāfiʿ, Syrians, Sahl and Yaʿqūb.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r4.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm is its middle and greatest part.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p127#4/r4.anchor: ﴿ إلى سواء الجحيم ﴾ إلى وسطها ومعظمها

QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r1.claim: The command “Take him” is addressed to the keepers of Hell and refers to the sinner.
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { خذوه } أي يقال للزبانية خذوه يعني الأثيم

QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r2.claim: Iʿtilūhu means drag and drive him; ʿatl is seizing a man by the lapels and pulling him violently toward imprisonment or calamity.
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r2.anchor: والعتل: أن تأخذ بتلابيب الرجل فتعتله، أي تجره إليك لتذهب به إلى حبس

QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r3.claim: The verb denotes violent pulling; a cited horse poem uses its lām form.
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r3.anchor: عتلت الرجل أعتله وأعتله عتلا إذا جذبته جذبا عنيفا. ورجل معتل بالكسر

QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r4.speaker: ابن السكيت
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r4.claim: Ibn al-Sikkīt reports two forms, ʿatala and ʿatana, with lām and nūn.
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r4.anchor: وفيه لغتان عتله وعتنه باللام والنون جميعا، قاله ابن السكيت

QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r5.speaker: الكوفيون، أبو عمرو
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r5.claim: The Kufans and Abū ʿAmr read iʿtilūhu with kasra; the remaining readers use ḍamma.

QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:44:47-48/r6.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means the middle of Hell.
